gripOrHq.title: Anonymous Tip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Derez a piece of black ice of your choice.

gripOrHq.title: Skivviss
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

gripOrHq.title: Evil Twin
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[3]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or brain damage total each turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

rig.title: Pattel’s Virus
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pattel counter on a piece of ice that had all its subroutines broken during that run. Each Pattel counter on a piece of ice reduces its strength by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

rig.title: Baedeker’s Net Map
rig.rulesText: [0]: Base link 1. [1]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Chihuahua
root.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

root.title: Snowbank
root.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

root.title: Coyote
root.rulesText: *For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength, unless Runner pays [2] while passing Coyote. Gain [3] when you rez Coyote.

ice.title: Colonel Failure
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *End the run. *End the run.

root.title: Syd Meyer Superstores
root.rulesText: A: Trash a rezzed piece of ice. Gain [4].

setAside.title: Afreet
setAside.rulesText: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU. All icebreakers hosted on Afreet have their strength reduced by 1. If Afreet leaves play, trash all programs hosted on it.
